headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 13, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Milwaukee Brewers, winning 14-5 behind a strong performance from their offense. Henry Davis led the Pirates' charge with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. In other action, the Baltimore Orioles defeated the Kansas City Royals 8-2, with Leody Taveras leading the Royals' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Curtis Mead leading the offense with a home run and one RBI.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Arizona Diamondbacks right-hander Zac Gallen, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Other players on the injured list include Chris Martin of the Texas Rangers, Nick Lodolo of the Cincinnati Reds, William Kempner of the Miami Marlins, Brandon Woodruff of the Milwaukee Brewers, Mike Yastrzemski of the Atlanta Braves, Anthony Banda of the Minnesota Twins, and Nick Kurtz of the Athletics.

The Milwaukee Brewers have acquired shortstop Braden Shewmake from the Houston Astros, while the Chicago White Sox traded left-hander Brandon Eisert and first baseman Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for left-hander Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Toronto Blue Jays traded right-hander Tommy Nance to the Minnesota Twins for catcher Ryan Sprock and future considerations.

top_news.title: **Pirates Rout Brewers 14-5**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Milwaukee Brewers, winning 14-5 behind a strong performance from their offense. Henry Davis led the Pirates' charge with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Orioles in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles dominated the Kansas City Royals 8-2, handing them a tough loss. Leody Taveras led the Royals' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Nationals 5-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Curtis Mead leading the offense with a home run and one RBI. Ryan Yarbrough earned the win, while Paul Blackburn earned the save.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Reds 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-4 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Alex Bregman leading the offense. Bregman hit 3 home runs, including a key 9th homer that scored two runs.

top_news.title: **Gallen Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks right-hander Zac Gallen has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation, effective retroactive to July 9, 2026.

top_news.title: **Shewmake Joins Brewers**
top_news.summary: Braden Shewmake has been traded to the Milwaukee Brewers. The trade was announced on July 12, 2026.
